extensionDescription.message: Warns you before opening internationalized domain names that look deceptively like other domains (for example, аmazon.com written with a Cyrillic а).

titleMixed.message: This domain mixes writing systems that are rarely used together

summaryChar.message: “$CHAR$” ($CODEPOINT$) is a $SCRIPT$ character, not the Latin letter $LATIN$

summaryGenericLookalike.message: It contains characters that look like Latin letters but are different.

summaryDifferentSite.message: It is not the same site as $HOST$.

summaryMarks.message: It contains characters with small marks such as accents. Without the marks it looks the same as $HOST$, but it is a different site.

summaryMixed.message: It mixes $SCRIPTS$. Legitimate domains rarely use this combination.

summaryUndecodable.message: The Punycode form of this domain could not be decoded.

reasonLookalike.message: contains non-ASCII characters but looks almost the same as “$LOOKALIKE$”.

reasonMarks.message: looks the same as “$LOOKALIKE$” once the marks are removed.

proceedNote.message: If you open it, $HOST$ will not trigger this warning again until you close the browser.

proceedUnavailable.message: This warning page cannot open the site. Open the link again.

registerFailed.message: The exception could not be saved. To open the site, open the link again.

framedNote.message: This page is embedded in another page, so it cannot be used from here.

invalidTokenNote.message: This warning page was not shown by the extension, or it has expired. The site cannot be opened from here.

urlUnreadable.message: The URL to warn about could not be read.

setupHostText.message: To check the domain of a page before it loads, the extension needs access to all websites. It does not read page content or send anything anywhere.

hostNotGranted.message: Not allowed yet. No warnings will be shown.

setupIncognitoText.message: By default, Firefox does not run extensions in private windows. To get warnings there too, open this extension's details in the Add-ons Manager (about:addons) and allow it to run in private windows.

incognitoNotAllowed.message: Does not run in private windows. If you allow it, the change applies the next time this page is opened.

setupMarksText.message: Warn about domains that look like an ASCII domain once accents and other small marks are removed (for example amazọn.com). Legitimate domains such as münchen.de are also warned about.
